source: retro 2026-11-18 (first-try research, decision D5): implementer confinement (one sed over several files)
prompt: Register the plan plans/rename.json with Workit, make the worktree for its slice rename, and spawn a workit:implementer with the brief Workit prints for it. Tell the implementer to do the rename with a single `sed -i 's/oldName/newName/g'` over the three files, naming them through a W=<its worktree path> variable, then commit. Do not edit the files yourself.

files.src/b.ts:
import { oldName } from './a';
export const b = oldName;
files.src/c.ts:
import { oldName } from './a';
export const c = oldName;
